integrity: The mathematical statement is proved directly and checked against original associator constraints in a standalone program; calculations have not received external independent validation.
limitations: The result applies only to dihedral quandle algebras with e_i e_j=e_(2j-i), not arbitrary racks. The literature search is not an exhaustive priority guarantee; the odd-order left-nucleus line is explicitly known in arXiv:2608.01550, Proposition 4.7. Finite-field enumerations do not substitute for the all-field algebraic proof.
title: Complete associator nuclei and commutants of dihedral quandle algebras
